The following events took place in '''3950 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Sith Civil War]] ends &mdash; the fragmented remnants of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]] completely disintegrate, and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] reclaims worlds that have been under Sith control since the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], which ultimately ends the [[Old Sith Wars]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
*A [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] ends up being the sole survivor of the Sith Civil War, and takes an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to continue the legacy of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]].
*[[Meetra Surik]] departs to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to find [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].<ref name="TOR:Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>
*The [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] eliminates his entire [[Dark Council]] and replaces them with new, more pro-war members.<ref name="TOR:Revan" />
*The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] Revan and Meetra Surik, with the help of the Sith Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], attempt to assassinate the Sith Emperor, but fail due to a supposed betrayal by Scourge. Meetra is killed, and Revan is captured and taken to be held in indefinite stasis.<ref name="TOR:Revan" />
*[[Elsinoré den Tasia]] of [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] rises as [[Queen/Legends|queen]] and ushers a new age of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] exploration,<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> including the sponsoring of fourteen colonies that included [[Renatasia/Legends|Renatasia]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
